SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Phone privacy, WhatsApp numbers, CRM users and team supervisors.
SETTINGS.ERROR: Could not save, please try again

MASK_MODE.TITLE: Customer phone numbers
MASK_MODE.DESCRIPTION: Numbers are masked for everyone. Administrators can reveal a number, and every reveal is recorded.

SUPERVISORS.TITLE: Team supervisors
SUPERVISORS.DESCRIPTION: A supervisor sees the conversations of their team, including unassigned ones in the team inboxes, and can reassign them.

NUMBERS.TITLE: WhatsApp numbers
NUMBERS.DESCRIPTION: If the primary number is banned or disconnected, new conversations switch to the backup number automatically and administrators get an email.
NUMBERS.FAILBACK: Switch back to the primary number

WELCOME.TITLE: Welcome message
WELCOME.DESCRIPTION: Sent as a normal message when a new customer writes for the first time. Leave empty to turn it off.
WELCOME.PLACEHOLDER: Welcome to Shawky Group! A consultant will reply shortly.
WELCOME.CRM_WAIT: Seconds to wait for the CRM owner before round robin

CRM_USERS.TITLE: CRM users
CRM_USERS.DESCRIPTION: Link each CRM salesman username to a user here, so CRM launches and leads go to them.

SLA.TITLE: Response time and follow-up
SLA.REPLY_DELAY: Alert the supervisor when a customer waits longer than (minutes)
SLA.AUTO_REASSIGN: Also reassign the conversation to another online agent
SLA.FOLLOW_UP_DAYS: Show in Follow-up after (days without an agent message)

PHONE_MASKING.LABEL: Hide customer numbers from agents
PHONE_MASKING.DESCRIPTION: Agents and supervisors see •••507 instead of the number, and only administrators can search by phone or reveal a number.
PHONE_MASKING.CONFIRM: This changes what every agent sees right away.

RESTRICTED_VISIBILITY.LABEL: Agents see only their own conversations
RESTRICTED_VISIBILITY.DESCRIPTION: Agents see conversations assigned to them, supervisors see their teams. When off, everyone in an inbox sees all its conversations.
RESTRICTED_VISIBILITY.CONFIRM: This changes which conversations every agent can open right away.

GATEWAY_LAUNCH.LABEL: Open chats from the CRM gateway
GATEWAY_LAUNCH.DESCRIPTION: Lets the CRM WhatsApp button open conversations here through system.shawkygroup.com.
GATEWAY_LAUNCH.CONFIRM: The CRM WhatsApp button will start or stop working right away.

SWITCHES.MASKING_WARNING: Number hiding is not complete until the CRM sends a temporary code instead of the number.

GATEWAY.NOT_CONFIGURED: Gateway URL or API key is missing on the server.

ERRORS.EXPIRED: This CRM link has expired. Press the WhatsApp button in the CRM again.
ERRORS.INVALID_LEAD: The CRM did not send a valid WhatsApp number for this lead.
ERRORS.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again from the CRM.

FOLLOW_UPS.DESCRIPTION: Open conversations where no agent has written for a few days.
FOLLOW_UPS.EMPTY: Nothing to follow up. Well done!

REPORTS.DESCRIPTION: Export conversations for the records and estimate WhatsApp spend.

EXPORT.TITLE: Export conversations
EXPORT.DESCRIPTION: All conversations and messages in the date range. Every export is recorded in the audit log.
EXPORT.QUEUED: Export started. It will appear below when ready.

COSTS.TITLE: WhatsApp cost estimate
COSTS.DESCRIPTION: Based on the pricing Meta reports for each message. The first 1,000 service messages per number each month are free.
COSTS.NO_RATES: No rates entered yet: counts are shown, costs are 0.
COSTS.NAME: Name
COSTS.RATES_HELP: Rates in USD per message from Meta's rate card, by customer country code, plus a default. Example:
COSTS.INVALID_RATES: The rates are not valid JSON

AGENT_SCORES.DESCRIPTION: Average AI review score per agent over the last 7 days. Scores come from n8n and are never sent to customers.
